description.value: Delicado's Deli is a funky, high-energy southwestern cafe and deli serving food prepared fresh daily, including wraps, burritos, enchiladas, homemade soups, and fresh salads. An on-site mini-market stocks specialty hot sauces, freshly made salsas, and hummus, making it convenient for cyclists wanting to restock trail provisions. The Courtenay outlet is one of three BC franchise locations and offers both dine-in and takeout.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is the Courtenay franchise location of Delicado's Deli, matching the OSM phone number (250-338-8885) and street address (5th Street, Courtenay); OSM lists '180B' while the website shows '180 5th Street' — a minor unit-designation discrepancy. Takeout is explicitly advertised ('DINE IN / TAKEOUT') and the menu lists multiple vegetarian options (veggie roll-up, falafel, garden medley, veggie Thai). No bike-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere on the website.
concerns: OSM name 'Delicado's' omits 'Deli' — full business name on website is 'Delicado's Deli'.
OSM address lists '180B 5th Street' while website shows '180 5th Street' with no unit suffix; postal code V9N 1J4 taken from website only.
OSM cuisine tag is 'mexican' but the business self-describes as 'southwestern' throughout its website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active cafe/deli with dine-in and takeout, fresh healthy food, and clear vegetarian options — a useful food stop for touring cyclists passing through Courtenay.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu includes veggie roll-up (avocado, beans, tomato), falafel roll-up, garden medley (all-veggie), veggie Thai option, and oil-free hummus in the mini-market
